dict.string: Health Tracker needs access to your health data to sync it with your server.
Health Tracker writes to Apple Health the data entered from your web dashboard (body measurements and nutrition).
Health Tracker legge le tue cartelle cliniche (allergie, vaccinazioni, lab, farmaci, procedure, vital signs) per archiviarle nel tuo server self-hosted e consultarle dalla dashboard.
Health Tracker uses significant location changes only as a wake-up signal so it can sync new health data in the background. No location data is stored or sent anywhere.
